title: Block New Chrome Notification Requests | Real Settings Demo
viewer_problem: Chrome websites can interrupt browsing with repeated notification permission requests.
viewer_promise: Show genuine Chrome Settings and click the real Block default option in an isolated disposable demo profile, leaving real user settings untouched.

beats.spoken_purpose: Open on the real solved result from the same exact recording.
beats.action_or_result: Open with the real blocked notification default option selected in a disposable Chrome profile.

beats.spoken_purpose: Show the original live application and the user's problem.
beats.action_or_result: Chrome's real top-level chrome://settings page is shown in a fresh browser profile.

beats.spoken_purpose: Expose why the original result is misleading or hidden.
beats.action_or_result: Permission details are nested and not visible on the main Settings screen.

beats.spoken_purpose: Perform the real operation in the software.
beats.action_or_result: Use Selenium's real browser click to change the temporary-profile default notification permission option to Block.

beats.spoken_purpose: Verify the resulting application state without simulated images.
beats.action_or_result: Read back Chrome's actual selected Block option, rather than declaring success from a mock screen.

beats.spoken_purpose: Leave a concrete, qualified takeaway visible on the actual screen.
beats.action_or_result: Explain that only the throwaway demo profile changes, that the user should choose the right setting for their own browser, and that no account data is accessed.
